name: LLAMBO
org: University of Cambridge, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
one_liner: Integrates LLM conditional sampling into a Bayesian Optimization loop as a zero-shot warm-starter, surrogate model, and acquisition sampler.

loop.proposes: An LLM conditioned on the optimization history and problem metadata proposes candidate hyperparameter configurations.
loop.judged_by: True black-box objective evaluations (training and scoring ML models on Bayesmark / HPOBench) measure validation loss.
loop.steers: Expected Improvement utility scores rank candidate configurations and append the evaluated (x, f(x)) pair to the active-learning history.

headline_result: Outperformed Gaussian Process and Random Forest Bayesian Optimization baselines in the low-trial regime across 25 Bayesmark tasks.
caveat: In high-dimensional continuous spaces (>20 variables) with ratusan of trials, classical numerical GP kernels overtake in-context LLM surrogates.
beyond_harness_note: A sequential Bayesian Optimization active-learning loop queries the LLM for candidate proposals and scores them on the black-box objective.
generative_model: GPT-3.5 in-context surrogate and candidate sampler
algorithmic_authority: Expected Improvement acquisition ranker and black-box objective evaluator

sources.title: Large Language Models to Enhance Bayesian Optimization (ICLR 2024 / arXiv:2402.03921)

verification.notes: Checked against Liu et al., ICLR 2024.
